title: Messages Inbox
intro: Ten messages from people who say they know you. One minute. Some are real.
Swipe left if it is a scam, right if it is safe. Or tap the buttons.
Careful: some are honest. Do not cry wolf.

cards.text: Hi Mum, my phone broke, this is my new number. Can you pay a bill for me? Urgent.
cards.why: A new number, a money request and a rush: the classic "Hi Mum" scam.

cards.text: I land on the 14th at 3 PM! Video call on Sunday? No need to arrange anything.
cards.why: A long-time friend with a clear plan, offering a video call, and asking for nothing.

cards.text: I feel like I have known you for years. Let us move to a private app. 💕
cards.why: Fast love and a fast move off the app.

cards.text: Are you at your desk? I need 5 gift vouchers urgently. Send the codes.
cards.why: A "boss" on a new number asking for gift card codes.

cards.text: Wrong number? No, I am just saying hi. Coming to the wedding on Saturday?
cards.why: A cousin you know, asking about a wedding you both know about.

cards.text: My leave papers need $1,200. Please send it now, my love.
cards.why: Someone far away who needs money for papers.

cards.text: Hey, sorry, wrong number! But you seem nice. Let us chat? 😊
cards.why: A "wrong number" that turns into a friendship is how long cons start.

cards.text: My camera is broken again. Can you send me some money for a new phone?
cards.why: Never appears on video, and then asks for money.

cards.text: I earn $1,600 a week trading. Let me show you how.
cards.why: A friend you never met, offering secret earnings.

golden_rule: People you have not met in person, who ask for money or move you away, are the ones to check. Call people you know on numbers you know.

quick_check.q: A "wrong number" message turns into a friendly chat, and later asks you to invest. What is going on?

options.text: A long con that starts with a wrong number

quick_check.explain: Long cons often start with a harmless wrong number.
